newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-WEST INDIES V INDIA SECOND TEST TOSS/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES V INDIA SECOND TEST TOSS/TEAMS.

text.p: West Indies won the toss and decided to bat on the opening day of the second test against India at the Queen's Park Oval on Friday.
West Indies made one change from the side that drew the first test in Jamaica, Trinidadian fast Bowler Mervyn Dillon making his debut in place of injured countryman Ian Bishop.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Junior Murray, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Franklyn Rose, Mervyn Dillon.
India - Vangipurappu Laxman, Navjot Sidhu, Rahul Dravid, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Mohammad Azharuddin, Saurav Ganguly, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi, Abey Kuruvilla, Venkat Prasad.
